
# Final Plots

```{r}
rm(list = ls()) # Clear all objects from the environment
gc() # Run garbage collection to free memory

# Load required libraries

library(SYNCSA)

N = 1000 # number of elements (ie. trees or repetitions)
mems <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/mem_chl_traw.RDS") #spatial variables

```
## Raw traits plot
### Short Creeping Rhizome
```{r}
# Fit linear model for short creeping rhizome with environmental predictors
model <- lm(data = cwm_values, r_cr ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size)
# Extract effect of annual precipitation
eff <- effects::effect("ann_prec", model) %>%
  data.frame()
p1 <- ggplot(data = cwm_values, aes(x = ann_prec, y = r_cr)) +
  geom_point(# Scatter points
    fill = "#823f23",
    colour = "black",
    size = 3,
    shape = 21,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(data = eff, aes(x = ann_prec, y = fit), color = "black", lty = 4) + # Regression line
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif", base_size = 12) + # Styling
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 6.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Short-Creeping Rhizome CWM (Raw)", x = "Annual Rainfall (mm)") # Axis labels

p1
```
### Spore Chlorophyll
```{r}
# Fit model with interaction between annual precipitation and precipitation seasonality
model <- lm(
  chl ~ ann_prec * prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size + MEM5 + MEM1,
  data = cwm_values
)

# Set colour palete
cols <- rev(c("#003817", "coral"))
# Create interaction plot using interact_plot
p2 <- interactions::interact_plot(
  model,
  pred = ann_prec,
  modx = prec_seas,
  data = cwm_values,
  plot.points = T,
  vary.lty = T,
  point.shape = T,
  point.size = 3,
  point.alpha = 1,
  modx.value = 'terciles', 
  partial.residuals = T,
  colors = 'Paired',
  x.label = "Annual Rainfall (mm)",
  y.label = "Spore Chlorophyll (Raw)",
  legend.main = "Rain. Seas. (%CV)"
)+ theme_minimal()+
labs(caption = 'Meadian of terciles = 10.1%, 11.1%, 22.9%')+
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      family = "serif",
      size = 6.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
        legend.position = 'bottom',
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2)
  )

# Interactions in complicated...
# We need to overwrite some parameters inside the object
# and insert others
p2
 p2$layers[[2]]$aes_params$shape <- 21
 p2$layers[[2]]$mapping$colour <- aes(colour = prec_seas)$colour
 p2$layers[[2]]$mapping$fill <- aes(fill = prec_seas)$fill
 p2$layers[[2]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"

p2


```
### SES.MPD plot
```{r}

# Load model and data for SES.MFD (standardized effect size of mean pairwise distance)
ses_mod <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/raw_ses_mod_ab.RDS")
org_data <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/raw_ses_mod_data.RDS")
ses_mpd_full <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/ses_mpd_full.RDS")

# My palette, it works for colorblindness
cols <- rev(c("#fcfcd4", "#8cdfff", "#003b55"))

# Create interaction plot for SES.MFD vs. temp and seasonality
p3 <- interactions::interact_plot(
  ses_mod,
  pred = max_temp_wam,
  modx = prec_seas,
  data = ses_mpd_full,
  plot.points = T,
  vary.lty = T,
  point.shape = T,
  point.size = 3,
  modx.value = 'terciles', 
  colors = 'red',
  x.label = "Max. Temperature in Warmest Month (°C)",
  line.thickness = .6,
  y.label = "SES.MFD Traits (Raw)",
  legend.main = "Rain. Seas. (%CV)"
) +
labs(caption = 'Meadian of terciles = 10.1%, 11.1%, 22.9%')+
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      family = "serif",
      size = 6.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
        legend.position = 'bottom',
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2)
  )
# Interactions in complicated...
# We need to overwrite some parameters inside the object
# and insert others
p3$layers[[2]]$aes_params$shape <- 21
p3$layers[[2]]$mapping$colour <- aes(colour = prec_seas)$colour
p3$layers[[2]]$mapping$fill <- aes(fill = prec_seas)$fill
p3$layers[[2]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"
p3
```

## Corrected plots
### Short-Creeping Rhizome
```{r}
# Load organized and corrected data
org_all <- readRDS("data/org_data.RDS")
scomp <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/SCOMP.RDS")
models <- read_xlsx(
  "outputs/Corrected/mod_select_cwm.xlsx",
  sheet = "nice_mode_S"
)[, -1]
cwm_data <- read_xlsx("outputs/Corrected/cwm_sig_tcor.xlsx", sheet = "full_result")

ses.mpd_data <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/ses.tcor_mdp_ab.RDS")

# Organize community data for each simulation
org_data <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_all$community,
        # Organized traits
      traits = data.frame(
        diam = scomp$riz_diam[[i]],
        rcomp = scomp$riz_comp[[i]],
        r_cr = scomp$riz_cr[[i]],
        r_lr = scomp$riz_lr[[i]],
        lmseg = scomp$lam_mseg[[i]],
        buds = scomp$buds[[i]],
        ltri = scomp$ltri[[i]],
        chl = scomp$chl[[i]],
        ind = scomp$ind[[i]],
        lmorf = scomp$lmorf[[i]]
      ),
      envir = org_all$environmental
    )
  }


rrc_data <- cwm_data %>% filter(grepl("r_cr", model))

# Select simulation with r2 closest to mean
n <- filter(
  rrc_data,
  near(mean(adj.r.squared), adj.r.squared, tol = .0000025)
)$...1 %>%
  as.numeric()
n
#Computing cwm with data
cwm_rc <- matrix.t(
  traits = data.frame(t = org_data[[n]]$traits$r_cr),
  comm = org_data[[n]]$community,
  scale = F
)$matrix.T

#Combine plot data
rc_p <- cbind.data.frame(
  cwm_rc,
  AP = org_data[[n]]$environmental$ann_prec,
  PS = org_data[[n]]$environmental$prec_seas,
  P = org_data[[n]]$environmental$plot_size,
  S = org_data[[n]]$environmental$samp_size,
  labs = rownames(cwm_rc)
)

# Fit model
model <- lm(t ~ AP + PS + P + S, data = rc_p)

# Get effects
eff1 <- as.data.frame(effects::effect("AP", model))
eff2 <- as.data.frame(effects::effect("PS", model))

# Plot effects of annual precipitation
p4 <- ggplot(data = rc_p) +
  geom_point(aes(x = AP, y = t),
    col = "black",
    fill = '#823a00',
    size = 3,
    shape = 22,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(data = eff1, aes(x = AP, y = fit), color = "black", lty = 4) +
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      family = "serif",
      size = 6.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Short-Creeping Rhizome CWM (Corrected)", x = "Annual Rainfall (mm)")

p4

p5 <- ggplot(data = rc_p) +
  geom_point(aes(x = PS, y = t),
    col = "black",
    fill = '#823a00',
    size = 3,
    shape = 22,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(data = eff2, aes(x = PS, y = fit), color = "black", lty = 4) +
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      family = "serif",
      size = 6.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Short-Creeping Rhizome CWM (Corrected)", x = "Rainfall Seasonallity (%CV)")

p5
```

### SES MPD 
```{r}
# Load results and prepare SES MPD data
result_ses.all <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/tcor-result_ses_ab.RDS")
ses.mpd_all <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/ses.tcor_mdp_ab.RDS")

# Add tree identifiers
ses_data <- cbind.data.frame(result_ses.all[1:1000, ], tree = seq(1, 1000, 1))

# Select best scenario
n_ses <- dplyr::filter(ses_data, near(mean(ses_data$adj.r.squared), adj.r.squared, tol = .000018))$tree %>% as.numeric()

# Combine data for model
df <- cbind.data.frame(
  ses = ses.mpd_all[[n_ses]]$mpd.obs.z,
  mt = org_data[[n_ses]]$environmental$max_temp_wam,
  ps = org_data[[n_ses]]$environmental$prec_seas,
  p = org_data[[n_ses]]$environmental$plot_size,
  s = org_data[[n_ses]]$environmental$samp_size
)
# Fit model
mod <- lm(ses ~ mt * ps + p + s, data = df)
# Plot interaction
p6 <- interactions::interact_plot(
  mod,
  pred = mt,
  modx = ps,
  data = df,
  modx.value = 'terciles',
  plot.points = T,
  jitter = .01,
  partial.residuals = F,
  vary.lty = T,
  point.shape = T,
  point.size = 3,
  se = F,
  colors = "red",
  point.alpha = 1,
  x.label = "Max. Temperature in Warmest Month (°C)",
  line.thickness = .6,
  y.label = "SES.MFD Traits (Corrected)",
  legend.main = "Rain. Seas. (%CV)"
) +
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      family = "serif",
      size = 6.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
        legend.position = 'bottom',
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = 2, linewidth = .2)
  )

# Modify layers for consistency
p6$layers[[2]]$aes_params$shape <- 22
p6$layers[[2]]$mapping$colour <- aes(colour = ps)$colour
p6$layers[[2]]$mapping$fill <- aes(fill = ps)$fill
p6$layers[[2]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"
p6
```

## Plot Phylogenetic Tree

```{r}
library(ggstar)  # Load the ggstar package for enhanced plotting features in ggtree

# Load taxonomic data and replace underscores with spaces in species names
tax <- ftolr::ftol_taxonomy  
tax$species <- gsub("_", " ", tax$species)

# Read the phylogenetic tree and clean tip labels (replace "_" with space)
tree <- read.tree("data/new_ftrees.txt")[[1]]  
tree$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", tree$tip.label)  

# Load the dataset containing community and trait data
org_data <- readRDS("data/org_data.RDS")  

# Clean up the trait and community matrix labels to match tree tips
rownames(org_data$traits) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(org_data$traits))  
colnames(org_data$community) <- gsub("_", " ", colnames(org_data$community))  

# Match tree tips with trait data and create a column with species labels
trait <- org_data$traits[match(tree$tip.label, rownames(org_data$traits)), ] %>% 
  mutate(label = rownames(.))

# Create binary matrix (presence/absence) for a subset of traits (columns 2 to 10)
t <- data.frame(ifelse(trait[, 2:10] == 1, 1, 0), label = rownames(trait))

# Reshape data for plotting; each row becomes a trait-species pair
dat2 <- reshape2::melt(t, id = "label", variable.name = "traits", value.name = "value")  
dat2$value <- paste0(dat2$traits, dat2$value)  # Combine trait names with values

# Remove trait values ending in 0 (absent traits)
dat2$value[grepl("0$", dat2$value)] <- NA  
dat2 <- dat2[!is.na(dat2$value), ]  
dat2$value <- as.factor(dat2$value)  # Convert to factor for plotting

# Define color palettes
col <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")  
col2 <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Set3")  
b2 <- seq(from = 1, to = 8, by = 2)  # Define breaks for diameter gradient

cols2 <- c("white", "Black", "Grey50", "Grey10")  # Unused color vector
cols <- c('gray80', 'coral', 'coral4' )           # Unused color vector

# Calculate mean frequency (abundance) of each species across all sites
freq_mean <- apply(org_data$community, 2, mean) %>%  
  as_tibble(rownames = "label") %>%  
  arrange(factor(label, levels = tree$tip.label)) %>%  
  `colnames<-`(c("label", "freq"))

# Display min and max of species frequencies (rounded)
round(range(freq_mean$freq),2)

# Construct phylogenetic tree object and add frequency data to it
p <- ggtree(tree, layout = "rect", open.angle = 4, size = 0.2) %<+% freq_mean

# Plot the tree with annotated traits and additional data layers
p + 
  xlim(-600, 2400) +  # Expand x-axis limits to make room for annotations
  geom_tiplab(        # Add species names
    size = 3.1,
    fontface = 'italic',
    linesize = .2,
    offset = 10,
    align = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_tippoint(size = 1, col = "black", alpha = 1) +  # Add dots at tree tips

  # Add presence/absence of traits as colored tiles ("geom_tile")
  geom_fruit(
    data = dat2,
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(x = value, y = label, fill = value),
    width = 50,
    color = "white",
    pwidth = 1,
    offset = .65,
    grid.params = list(linetype = 3, size = 0.2)
  ) +

  # Define manual color scale for trait presence tiles
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Trait Presence",
    labels = c(
      "Proliferous Buds",
      "Spore Chlorophyll",
      "Indusium",
      "Laminae Dimorphism",
      "Multipinnate Laminae",
      "Pubescent Laminae",
      "Compact Rhyzome",
      "Short Creeping Rhyzome",
      "Long Creeping Rhyzome"
    ),
    values = col2,
    na.translate = TRUE,
    guide = guide_legend(
      keywidth = 0.5,
      keyheight = 0.5,
      order = 2
    )
  ) +

  # Add rhizome diameter as a heatmap-style tile
  new_scale("fill") +  # Start new fill scale
  geom_fruit(
    data = trait,
    aes(y = label, fill = trait[[1]]),  # First trait column assumed to be diameter
    geom = geom_tile,
    width = 50,
    pwidth = .8,
    offset = .15,
    col = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_steps(  # Continuous fill for rhizome diameter
    low= 'gray73',
    high = 'black',
    breaks = b2,
    name = "Rhizome Diameter (cm)"
  ) +

  # Add mean species frequency as bar plots
  new_scale("fill") +  # Start another fill scale
  geom_fruit(
    geom = geom_bar,
    aes(y = label, x = freq, fill = "Mean"),
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = .5,
    offset = .1,
    pwidth = 0.9,
    stat= 'identity',
    grid.params = list(linetype = 3, size = 0.2)
  ) +
  labs(fill = 'Frequency (%)') +  # Label for fill legend

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 360, 5)) +  # Custom y-axis ticks (optional here)

  new_scale("fill") +  # Allow for another fill layer if needed in future

  # Final theme settings for plot appearance
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "mm"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(
      color = 'grey80',
      linewidth = 0.2,
      linetype = "dotted"
    ),
    legend.position = 'bottom'  # Move legends to bottom
  )

ggsave(
  "figs/heatphylo_rect.jpg",
  device = "jpg",
  dpi = 600,
  scale = 1.5,
  width = 180,
  height = 180,
  units = "mm"
)
```

# No used - Graph of phylogenetic signal
```{r}
sig <- map_df(D_list, ~ as.data.frame(.))
sig$trait <- c(
  rep('RComp', 1000),
  rep("RSC", 1000),
  rep("RLC", 1000),
  rep("LMSeg", 1000),
  rep("LDim", 1000),
  rep("LPub", 1000),
  rep("Buds", 1000),
  rep("Ind", 1000),
  rep("Chl", 1000),
  rep("RDiam", 1000)
)

D <- sig %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_D = mean(D),
    max_D = max(D),
    min_D = min(D),
    sd_D = sd(D),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(!(trait == "RDiam" | trait == "LINT"))

K <- sig %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_D = mean(K),
    max_D = max(K),
    min_D = min(K),
    sd_D = sd(K),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  na.omit()
df <- rbind(K, D) %>% mutate(Method = c(rep("K", 1), rep("D", 9)))
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = trait, y = mean_D)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_D + 2 * sd_D,
      ymax = mean_D - 2 * sd_D,
      color = Method,
      fill = Method
    ),
    size = 1,
    shape = 22
  ) +
  # geom_text_repel(aes(label = sites),  color = "black", size = 2)+
  labs(y = "Signal Value", x = "Traits") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_line(linetype = 2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "gray")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "gray")) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), lty = 2, col = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5), n.breaks = 10) +
  labs(
    caption = 'Pointrange corresponds to 2 standard deviations from the mean'
  )

ggsave(
  "figs/sig-trait.tiff",
  width = 180,
  height = 150,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
